'''Kerkum''' was a individual who worked as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
When the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]] returned to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and deposed Nirama to regain control of crime in the system, Kerkum and [[Mattenic]], another of Nirama's lieutenants, went into hiding inside an abandoned factory situated in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled to the factory to meet with the pair, but encountered a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who had been sent by Riboga to capture Kerkum and Mattenic.
